svg.title: Action ribbons through three retained playbook versions
svg.text: The same gate task is rerun under each retained policy. The checkpoint stays on.
Rounds 3 and 4 evaluated new rules but retained no change; their policy ribbon remains the round-2 version.
Fixed 60-task gate; one stochastic run per task and version. Sealed exam contains only start and final versions.
